prompt: A fixed, slightly fisheyed, washed-out view from a lens on a kitchen shelf, looking across a small downstairs flat kitchen at Jenny standing at a counter with a mug in one hand, head tipped back, brows raised high, eyelids wide, mouth open, eyes aimed at the ceiling. The plaster above her sags in a heavy brown bulge, with water streaming from a crack and splashing on the lino beside her. A pendant light swings slightly, a calendar hangs on the fridge door, and the colours are bleached with grain. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
